subtitle: Out Cebu · Xiamen Airlines
overview: Fly with Xiamen Airlines from Cebu via Quanzhou, then travel by private coach with an English-speaking guide. You will see Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, the Avatar “Hallelujah Mountain” scenery, the Grand Canyon glass bridge and Furong Town, the ancient town hanging on a waterfall. The tour ends in Chongqing with its light rail through buildings and the night view of Hongya Cave. Stays are in local 5-star hotels, except a 4-star hotel in Quanzhou on the first night.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Nov 17–24 2026 to Mar 16–23 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Quanzhou: A historic port city in Fujian, where the tour lands and spends the first night.
placeDesc.Changsha IFS: A large modern shopping and entertainment complex in downtown Changsha.
placeDesc.Huangxing Pedestrian Street: Changsha's central pedestrian shopping street, busy with shops, snacks and street life.
placeDesc.Pozijie Food Street: A well-known street in Changsha's old quarter lined with local Hunan snack stalls.
placeDesc.Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (Avatar: A park of tall sandstone pillars in Hunan, famous as the inspiration for the floating mountains in Avatar.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A tall outdoor glass elevator built against a cliff, used to go up and down in the Avatar scenic area.
placeDesc.No.1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge in the Zhangjiajie park, a scenic viewing stop in the Avatar area.
placeDesc.Breath-taking Platform: A viewing platform in the Avatar scenic area with sweeping views of the sandstone pillars.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: The pillar mountain in Zhangjiajie that inspired the floating Hallelujah Mountains in the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Tianzi Mountain: A scenic mountain in the Zhangjiajie area with forests of sandstone peaks and wide lookouts.
placeDesc.Golden Whip Stream: A scenic stream valley in Zhangjiajie, walked between rock walls and forest.
placeDesc.Water Around Four Gates: A scenic stop in the Zhangjiajie park area, visited together with Golden Whip Stream.
placeDesc.Junsheng Sandstone Painting Museum: A museum in Zhangjiajie showing paintings made with local sandstone.
placeDesc.72 Wonder Tower: A tall tower in Zhangjiajie, seen from outside on this tour.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon C Line Glass Bridge: A glass-floored bridge across a canyon near Zhangjiajie, visited with a VR experience.
placeDesc.Furong Town: An ancient Tujia town built beside a waterfall, visited with a battery bus and a sightseeing boat.
placeDesc.Liziba Station: A Chongqing metro station where the light rail runs through a residential building, a popular photo spot.
placeDesc.Kuixing Tower: A Chongqing building where the 22nd floor feels like ground level because of the hillside layout.
placeDesc.Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street: The central pedestrian shopping district of Chongqing, with the Liberation Monument at its centre.
placeDesc.Hongya Cave: A stilted riverside complex in Chongqing that lights up at night, visited for its night view.
